note: M.5E FINAL Section 33 Corpus Maturity Matrix. Deliberately NOT a composite score -- 17 independent dimensions, each judged on its own evidence.

SOURCE_DIVERSITY.limitation: counts distinct feeds, not distinct owning organizations -- e.g. src_구글뉴스_ai_정책 and src_google_news_ai_regulation are the same aggregator counted twice

PRIMARY_SOURCE_COVERAGE.limitation: primary/secondary is source_id-verified per M.5F Section 23's correction, not the raw category field

ACADEMIC_COVERAGE.limitation: counts arXiv/Crossref-tagged source_ids only; does not verify peer-review status of each individual document

POLICY_RESEARCH_COVERAGE.measurement: count of documents whose source_id matches a known policy-research-institute pattern (KDI/KIET/KEEI/KOSTAT/KISTEP/KRIHS/KREI)
POLICY_RESEARCH_COVERAGE.method: direct source_id substring check, same pattern as deep_pilot_v2.py's POLICY_RESEARCH_CONTEXT node
POLICY_RESEARCH_COVERAGE.limitation: 0 confirmed -- no Korean policy-research-institute source is registered in this corpus at all; this is a real coverage gap, not a measurement artifact

STATISTICAL_COVERAGE.limitation: 0 confirmed in prior rounds -- no World Bank/EIA/KOSTAT-class source registered; a real gap

TEMPORAL_DEPTH.measurement: earliest to latest published date span in years
TEMPORAL_DEPTH.limitation: span is dominated by a handful of historical outliers (earliest 1990s document); the real working corpus is concentrated in 2025-2026 -- a wide span is not the same as dense longitudinal coverage

LONGITUDINAL_CONTINUITY.measurement: TRANSITION-bucket document count across the two rebuilt Deep Pilots
LONGITUDINAL_CONTINUITY.method: deep_pilot_v2 TRANSITION node status, both pilots
LONGITUDINAL_CONTINUITY.limitation: 0/2 pilots have a real document bridging baseline and current state -- longitudinal continuity is a named, honest gap, not assumed solved by a wide date range

GEOGRAPHIC_COVERAGE.measurement: GEOGRAPHIC_CONTEXT node status across the two rebuilt Deep Pilots
GEOGRAPHIC_COVERAGE.limitation: documents.json has no jurisdiction/event_country/affected_region field at all -- this is a schema gap, not a search failure

TOPIC_COVERAGE.limitation: 73 USEFUL_BUT_UNCLASSIFIED documents sample-audited (Section 26 of this round) -- mostly genuinely off-topic, a small borderline minority remains an honest small gap, not forced closed

COUNTEREVIDENCE_COVERAGE.measurement: COUNTEREVIDENCE node status across the two rebuilt Deep Pilots
COUNTEREVIDENCE_COVERAGE.limitation: 0/2 pilots have real counterevidence connected; Section 28's candidate hypothesis list was not yet searched against the live corpus this round

HISTORICAL_COVERAGE.measurement: HISTORICAL_CONTEXT node status across the two rebuilt Deep Pilots
HISTORICAL_COVERAGE.limitation: 0/2; historical_analogy.py's build_analogy_v2() pipeline exists and is tested but was not re-run against either pilot topic this round

ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATION_COVERAGE.measurement: ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATION node status across the two rebuilt Deep Pilots
ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATION_COVERAGE.limitation: Section 29's candidate list was not yet searched this round -- QUERY_GAP, not evidence that no alternative explanation exists

PROVENANCE_COMPLETENESS.measurement: fraction of documents with a real canonical_url and source_id
PROVENANCE_COMPLETENESS.method: direct field presence check on documents.json
PROVENANCE_COMPLETENESS.limitation: presence of a URL/source_id is not itself verification the link resolves live (not checked in this offline round)

METADATA_QUALITY.limitation: 0 METADATA_POOR documents found in the real corpus as of this snapshot

ACCESSIBILITY.measurement: fraction of documents with rights_mode allowing at least a lawful link
ACCESSIBILITY.limitation: 100% LINK_ONLY is a copyright-safety strength but means 0% of this corpus has any stored full text -- 'accessible' here means 'has a lawful link', not 'full text immediately usable'

COPYRIGHT_SAFETY.measurement: fraction of documents NOT storing full text (rights_mode == LINK_ONLY)
COPYRIGHT_SAFETY.limitation: measures storage-boundary compliance only, not license verification per document (no RIGHTS_STATUS/LICENSE field exists in this schema yet -- see Section 3-12 Research Rights Model, not yet implemented this round)

EVIDENCE_INDEPENDENCE.limitation: a high aggregator share means many documents trace back to the same upstream wire story, inflating apparent source_id diversity
